title: The experience template, breakrocks.experience/4
description: The definition document of an experience of the engines route/1 and challenge/1 (contracts/experiences.md § The experience template, breakrocks.experience/4). Closed: an unknown field is refused; 16 KB at most in UTF-8 (DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE). The platform checks the rest (checkExperience): the visible characters, the name rules beyond this pattern, a name free in its owner, the route readable, the ranking measure supported by the engine, the parameters within the bounds of their field. The place feats keep breakrocks.experience/3 (engine presence/3), never this format.

id.description: Set by the platform at creation (<cell>-<UUIDv7>), kept across versions; given in createExperience, refused.

version.description: <major>.<minor>, set by the platform (absent in createExperience and updateExperience): 1.0 at creation; a change of the engine, of its block (unit, target, proof rules, hours), of the parameters or of the ranking is a new major; a change of the title, the instruction or the warnings a minor. A run keeps the version it started with.

engine.description: The engine and its version, from the registry of experience engines (engines.json).

owner.description: The owner of the experience, the first part of its address: an account (@<handle>), a universe (%<path>) or the root universe (%root, the experiences of the social platform, written *<name>).

name.description: Its name, by the rules of a channel name (2 to 50 visible characters, or 1 letter that stays non-ASCII, lowercase, beginning with a letter), unique among the experiences, the place feats and the routes of its owner; never the name of an experience kind.

warnings.description: The experience warnings the creator declares, shown before a run starts.

ranking.description: challenge/1 only, declared by the creator: the experience participants of one group experience instance are ranked on this measure (the measure of the challenge), in this order. Absent: no ranking.

parameters.description: challenge/1 only: the experience parameters a reuse (the sign ":") may change, each bound to one field of the engine block, one per field, keys unique, min <= default <= max (checked by the platform: PARAMETER_KEY_TWICE, PARAMETER_FIELD_TWICE, PARAMETER_BOUNDS_INVALID, PARAMETER_OUT_OF_BOUNDS); absent: none.

copiedFrom.description: Set by the platform on a copy: the experience copied and its version; given by a caller, refused.

route.description: The engine route/1: the route the experience is, by its identifier.

text30.description: 1 to 30 visible characters per language (TEXT_TOO_LONG, counted by the platform and the checker); the maxLength below is a cap in code points (4 per visible character), not the rule.

text100.description: 1 to 100 visible characters per language (TEXT_TOO_LONG); maxLength is a cap in code points, not the rule.

text500.description: 1 to 500 visible characters per language (TEXT_TOO_LONG); maxLength is a cap in code points, not the rule.

key.description: The key of the experience parameter in a reuse (":count=50"); never "id".

field.description: The field of the engine block it sets (challenge/1: target, the value of target.atLeast or target.atMost; endsWithinHours).

measure.description: COUNT: a counter (repetitions, in its unit); TIME: a timer (seconds); NONE: nothing to measure, the proof alone.

target.description: Optional: COUNT, atLeast (1 to 100,000); TIME, atLeast (hold for) or atMost (done within), in seconds (1 to 86,400); NONE, none. Without a target, any final measure meets it.

media.description: The media kinds a proof may be: IMAGE (a photo), VIDEO (a clip, 3 minutes at most).

validation.description: Who validates a proof: ORGANIZER (the organizer of a group run), PARTICIPANT_VOTE (the other participants of a group run), SELF_REPORTED (nobody; the proof is optional and the result marked self-reported).

endsWithinHours.description: A run ends at the latest this many hours after it went in progress (1 to 168).
